words.definition: 纬度；活动范围；宽度； 界限
words.mnemonic: lat-(=wide: 宽的)+itude (度) → 宽度；范围；纬度(“纬度”的
examples:
A teacher deserves wide latitude in selecting the method of grading that best promotes learning in her classroom;that is,after all,the prime function of grades.
教师应有很大的自由去选择评分方法，只要该方法可以促进班里的学 习即可，毕竟、促进班级学习是打分的首要作用。

words.definition: 奴隶状态；劳役，奴役；地役权
words.mnemonic: serv (来自奴仆，奴隶)+itude ( 表状态) →处于被奴役的状态 →奴 隶状态；奴役

words.etymology: early 15c.,"condition of being enslaved,"from Old French servitude, servitute(13c.)and directly from Late Latin servitudo "slavery,"from Latin servus “a slave”(see serve(v.))+abstract noun suffix.
